visualCharacteristics: Base: cells side by side from tablet up, stacked on mobile; image cells get columns-img-col and are shown first when stacked. Option columns-about: image + text two-up with rounded 4:3 image. Option columns-promo: narrow two-up bordered promo cards with ghost buttons. Option columns-pullquote: gear list next to a dark pull-quote panel. Option columns-divider: two text-only columns separated by a thin vertical divider line, hidden when the columns stack on mobile.
contentPattern: One row with one cell per column. Cells hold default content (headings, paragraphs, lists, links, buttons) or a single image. JS classifies each cell as columns-img-col or columns-text-col.
usage: Side-by-side content. Use columns-divider for two text columns (e.g. member info next to login/contact info) that need a vertical rule between them.
reuseGuidance: Keep the one-row, one-cell-per-column model. Prefer an existing option before adding a new one.
